How to apply

Four simple steps to express your interest.

AMEF has not published fixed volunteer roles or eligibility requirements. The team will confirm availability, expectations and any role-specific requirements directly.

01

Learn about AMEF

Review the Foundation’s programmes and choose the area where your experience or interests may be useful.

02

Prepare your details

Include your contact information, location, relevant skills or experience, area of interest and availability.

03

Send your application

Complete the form below. It prepares an email addressed to AMEF for you to review and send from your email application.

04

Confirm the opportunity

Wait for AMEF to contact you about current needs, suitability, expectations and next steps before making plans to volunteer.

Volunteer application

Tell AMEF how you would like to help.

Complete the form with a short introduction. Selecting “Prepare email application” opens your email application with the details filled in; review the message and send it to AMEF.

Prefer to apply directly?

Email info@amefuganda.org with the subject “Volunteer application”, or WhatsApp +256 775 749226.

This form does not upload or store your information. Your email application must open and be sent to reach AMEF.

Apply through a confirmed AMEF channel.

A volunteer placement is only confirmed after direct follow-up from AMEF. Do not send money or sensitive documents with your initial application.
